protocol.title: The puddle, the Pomeranian and the bone
protocol.feedback: One conditional execution repair, no aesthetic feedback
protocol.servingVariants: Standard preferred; one model/version, no Fast duplicate
protocol.visualScoring: Qualitative film inspection; seven visual criteria, no automatic aesthetic points or model self-reported score
protocol.infrastructureFailure: Unavailable, never a fabricated rendering failure or zero aesthetic score
protocol.capture: Offline isolated Chromium; actual viewport screenshots, not model telemetry; deterministic offline capture encoded at 30 fps
protocol.outputLimitPolicy: 32768 requested; GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini provider maximum 16384
protocol.thinkingPolicy: Low where supported; Haiku optional thinking disabled; native settings otherwise
protocol.subject: Pomeranian

calibration.note: The earlier doghouse-only V3 recordings and usage are archived separately and excluded from this new task. Every V4 result is generated afresh from the new shared puddle-jump prompt.

methodology: Results use Microsoft Foundry, Google Vertex AI and OpenRouter APIs. OpenRouter requests fix one named model and upstream endpoint, without model/provider fallbacks. Private service configuration is excluded.

All 44 registered API models receive the byte-identical new initial prompt. One conditional execution repair for empty, truncated or unexecutable code; final response only, never best-of. No aesthetic feedback or organizer code edits. Every terminal creative response is included in tokens and price. No inherited V3 output is presented as V4.

One unchanged retry on interrupted transport or retryable 408/429/5xx. Deterministic API validation rejections are not resampled. Missing terminal usage remains explicitly unknown. A received terminal response is normalized without another model call.

Output tokens include provider-reported reasoning exactly once. For Vertex AI, output_tokens is candidatesTokenCount plus thoughtsTokenCount. Estimates use dated official rate snapshots; taxes, regions and promotional credit eligibility can change actual spend.
Record 360 actual 960×540 offline browser screenshots at 30 fps. The page only plays recorded films; candidate code never runs on this origin.

Seven visual criteria include puddle clearance, weight-bearing landing and water reflection. Technical checks measure execution and repeatability, not visual quality or task success. No automatic aesthetic score or self-rating.

Gemini 4 Argon received a disclosed user-requested framing correction after its first recording put the dog outside the canvas. Same initial task, original source plus visibility diagnostics, two total completed responses, final response retained. Both responses are included in cost and tokens; see FRAMING-CORRECTION.json. No organizer source edits. Other models are unchanged.

Two additional V4 models use the identical initial prompt through OpenRouter with a fixed upstream provider and no fallbacks. See OPENROUTER-V4.json. Their known inference cost is taken from terminal OpenRouter receipts, not a fabricated invoice or zero placeholder.

User-authorized additions and completion rescue. All initial prompts are byte-identical to V4. Execution repairs retain the final response, never best-of. All previous completed failed responses remain retained and included in totals. GLM uses OpenRouter; earlier interrupted usage remains unknown. Exact per-response request settings are retained in the result data.

GLM 5.3 Flash uses the identical initial prompt through OpenRouter with a fixed upstream provider and no fallbacks. See GLM-FLASH-V4.json. Their known inference cost is taken from terminal OpenRouter receipts, not a fabricated invoice or zero placeholder.
